ai.reason: The report records an internal-wire temperature rise of 61.9 K against its own 35 K limit. Product attribution, test conditions and substantial washing-machine-specific evidence are also unresolved.
ai.recommended_action: Resolve the measured failure and sample identity, complete the applicable assessments and issue a traceable replacement report before certification proceeds.
ai.conclusion: The submitted report does not demonstrate compliance with the supplied IEC requirements. Its recorded temperature-limit failure is decisive, while the conflicting power rating, incomplete Part 2 assessments and document-integrity defects independently prevent a reliable compliance decision.
